metrics.name: Strict acceptance
metrics.construct: End-to-end within-budget strict success of a planned attempt
metrics.status_mapping: an attempt counts only when the authoritative evaluator accepts it and its budget evidence is compliant or non-binding; everything else counts as zero

validation.method: contract tested in tests/multi-evaluator.test.ts and tests/export-release.test.ts

metrics.limitations: the authoritative evaluator is declared per release; changing it changes the primary estimand and must be preregistered
